facts.fact: The DGI director-general says telefiling through the E-Impôt module, launched January 2019, now covers all taxpayers and all taxes except a few spontaneous ones such as registration duties and vignettes.

The DGI director-general says telepayment, launched December 2021, is operational for all taxpayers of the computerised centres, who can pay taxes by bank transfer, with no mobile money or card payment yet.

systems.tiers: DGE, CIME, Bamako and regional centres
